description:
Full-text search across all SEC filing content.

Returns matching documents, relevance-ranked, with counts by form type and
year (forms, years) and how many distinct companies match (companies_found).
With limit 10 or less (the default), each result carries an excerpt:
the passage of the document where the most query terms meet, to judge the
hit without opening it. Page on with page= for more; a larger limit returns
no excerpts. For every occurrence in one document, use search_document.
Use this to find filings mentioning specific topics like "revenue growth",
"cybersecurity risk", "stock buyback", etc.

Across companies ("which companies mention X"), set by_company=True: one
result per company, its best-matching document with an excerpt, so a page of
10 is ten companies, in relevance order; page on for more. For the list of
companies to choose from, ask for up to 100 at once (limit=100: no excerpts,
so read the ones you pick with search_document or cik=). Without it a page
often holds several documents of one company. Narrow with form and year
first: a broad query matches thousands of companies (companies_found says
how many), and reading them all is rarely what the user wants. Then use cik=
for every match within one company.

Coverage: filings from 2020 onwards, except Forms 3/4/5, 144, N-PORT, 13F and
D. A search for an earlier year finds nothing (the response's coverage_note
says so); for older filings, list them with get_filings (cik, form,
from_date, to_date; back to 1993) and read them with search_document or
get_document. Users who need older years searched can email
support@beatandraise.com.

Args:
    query: Search query (e.g. "revenue growth", "cybersecurity risk factors")
    form: Filter by SEC form type (e.g. "10-K", "10-Q", "8-K")
    cik: The company's CIK, if known (search_companies gives it): narrows the
        search to that company's filings. E.g. for Clear Channel Outdoor's
        merger background, cik="0001334978" with query="go-shop confidentiality
        agreement", not the company name in query. Without it every company's
        filings are searched, and a name in query is matched as words.
    year: Filter by filing year (e.g. "2025")
    limit: Results per page (1-100, default 10; excerpts only up to 10)
    page: Page number (0-indexed)
    by_company: One result per company (its best match) instead of per document
name: search_filings
title: Search Filings
